description: The National Hurricane Center's chance of tropical-storm-force (39 mph+) and hurricane-force (74 mph+) winds within 5 days for Puerto Rico's towns, from NHC's latest advisory, while a storm is in play: the island's lead line ('42 of Puerto Rico's 78 towns have a 10% or better chance…') and, with `town`, that town's sentence and figures. `active: false` means no storm is in play and NHC has no odds for Puerto Rico — say so, never imply a threat. A chance, never a forecast that winds will come. Cite 787daily.com/hurricane/ and the National Hurricane Center with the advisory time returned.

town.description: A town (municipio), e.g. 'Ponce'; omit for the island

name: wind_odds
title: Hurricane wind odds by town
